name: Fairgrounds and Redhead Campground
waterfront_evidence: Esri imagery 2026-11-11 (half-widths 600, 220 and 110 m around 47.4771,-92.8892): the 16 back-in sites are two rows on the south edge of the Chisholm fairgrounds (sites 10-16 west of the access-road junction, about 47.4771,-92.8899; sites 1-9 east of it, about 47.4771,-92.8885, per the city's 'Map of Fairgrounds and Redhead Campground'), between the horse arenas and continuous woods. There is no lake, river or pond within the 1.2 km frame; the nearest water, Longyear Lake, is in town about 1.5 km to the northeast across US-169. Not waterfront.
inclusion_evidence: City of Chisholm, https://www.ci.chisholm.mn.us/campground (read 2026-11-11): 'The Chisholm Iron Trail Campground and the Fairgounds and Redhead Campground are owned & operated by the City of Chisholm.'; 'The Fairgrounds and Redhead Campground is located in beautiful Chisholm, MN, across from the Minnesota Discovery Center and Redhead Mountain Bike Park Trailhead'; 'For the Fairgrounds and Redhead Campground, we have 16 sites that offer water and electric hookups (50 or 30 amp).'; 'Daily Rates (we only offer daily rates at Fairgrounds and Redhead Campground)'; 'Reservations Available ONLINE at: CAMPLIFE.COM'. CampLife listing 6651542 'Fairgrounds and Redhead Camping', 1010 Discovery Drive (booking API read 2026-11-11): 16 'Back In' sites, each 'Sites are 40' wide be 50' long 1 additional tent OK', maxLength 40, equipment travel trailer / 5th wheel / motorhome / van / pop-up / tent; one-night stays sold on an ordinary date (Sat 2026-10-17: 15 of 16 sites open, $35.00 a night before CampLife's $3.50 charge and tax; 2-night quote $73.50). Event camping is a separate thing on the city page ('Overflow large group camping at the Redhead MTB Park Trailhead available during Redhead event weekends'). A separate place from Chisholm Iron Trail Campground (id 5524): 1.25 km south of it, south of US-169 beside the Minnesota Discovery Center, entered from Discovery Drive (address 1010 Discovery Drive), while 5524 is in town on the Hwy 73 service road (115 6th Ave SW). Real, city-run, publicly bookable drive-in RV campground a 23-ft rig fits.
note: City-run campground on the edge of the Chisholm fairgrounds, across from the Minnesota Discovery Center and the Redhead Mountain Bike Park trailhead. Open, grassy back-in sites beside the horse arenas. Showers and restrooms are at the city's Iron Trail Campground in town (the door code comes with the reservation). RVs are subject to the city's 10-year rule. --Claude

sites.note: All back-in; CampLife lists each site as 40 ft wide by 50 ft long, rigs to 40 ft, with room for one extra tent.

facilities.note: Dump station on the grounds (free with a reservation). Showers and restrooms with a door code are at the Iron Trail Campground, 1.2 km north in town.

fees.note: Daily rates only here (no weekly or monthly). Plus tax and CampLife's $3.50 booking charge.

booking.note: Booked on CampLife, which opens each season's dates only for the current season.
